name: speed-lines
title: Speed Lines
description: Comic-style motion streaks: a squashing ball leaves a trail as it lands, or rays rush out from a focus point.
useWhen: Something lands, zips in or snaps into focus and needs comic-style motion lines to sell the speed.
A hook, reveal or punchline needs radiating focus lines.
avoidWhen: A calm, polished product tone is needed: speed lines read as playful and loud.
The moving object is complex content: the trail mode draws a plain ball.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Mode
variables.description: trail: a ball travels from one point to another leaving streaks. focus: rays rush out of a point.

variables.label: From X
variables.description: Trail start across the frame (0 to 1; may sit outside the frame).

variables.label: From Y
variables.description: Trail start down the frame (0 to 1).

variables.label: X
variables.description: Landing or focus point across the frame, 0 to 1.

variables.label: Y
variables.description: Landing or focus point down the frame, 0 to 1.

variables.label: Weight
variables.description: Line thickness at a 720 px frame height.

variables.label: Spread
variables.description: Size of the ball and the spread of the streaks.

variables.label: Travel frames
variables.description: Frames (30 fps) the ball takes to arrive.

variables.label: Bounce
variables.description: How much the ball rebounds on landing.

variables.label: Squash
variables.description: How much the ball stretches and squashes.

variables.label: Line color
variables.description: Color of the lines and ball.

variables.label: Delay
variables.description: Frames (30 fps) before the motion starts.
